description: Ticker history on one exchange: which symbol an ISIN traded under, and over which dates. Use it to follow renames. Required: exchange, and one of symbol or isin. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. Tier: needs a free API key (https://tejhq.dev/keys).

exchange.description: Exchange: nse or bse, lower case.

isin.description: ISIN to look up, for example INE002A01018. Pass this or symbol.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

symbol.description: Ticker to look up. Pass this or isin.

name: symbols
title: Symbol history
